guide.audit.read: Open the Audit log: who did what, when and with what result; export to Excel. Only actions by people within your organization / unit.
guide.dashboard.access: Ticket to the admin website. Without it the account cannot sign in to the web (mobile app only), whatever else it has. Opens the Overview.
guide.device.read: View vehicles, their details, assigned officers and the vehicle type catalog within scope.
guide.device.manage: Add / edit / delete vehicles, assign or remove App officers, rotate the device connection key (MQTT).
guide.device_activity.read: Open Route history: replay a vehicle's GPS track (up to 24 hours at a time), distance and speed.
guide.device_activity.manage: Manage vehicle activity data (reserved for editing / deleting track data).
guide.gps.read: Open Live monitoring: real-time vehicle positions on the map, find vehicles near a point.
guide.incident.read: View incidents your unit created or has vehicles dispatched to: details, scene photos, handling log.
guide.incident.read.all: View ALL incidents in the organization subtree, even those not involving your vehicles — for duty officers / commanders.
guide.incident.manage: Create / edit / delete incidents, dispatch and recall vehicles, change status, approve completion and close.
guide.menu.read: View the system menu configuration (platform admin feature, not used on the web yet).
guide.menu.manage: Edit the menu configuration shared by all organizations (platform admins only).
guide.permission.read: View the permission catalog (needed for the permission / role screens).
guide.permission.manage: Edit the shared permission catalog (names, descriptions, grantable flag) — affects every organization.
guide.platform.bypass: Full system access: view and change data of EVERY organization, grant any permission. System administrators only.
guide.platform.read: Read data of every organization without changing it. Only activated temporarily, never assigned permanently.
guide.privilege.elevate: Allows self-elevation to temporary-only permissions (such as “Read whole system”). Root organization only.
guide.role.read: View roles and their permission bundles; needed to pick a role when creating / editing accounts.
guide.role.manage: Create your organization's own roles, edit bundles, delete unused roles. Only permissions you hold can go into a role.
guide.scope.device: Marks an officer's App account: only sees and acts on assigned vehicles. Adds no extra capability.
guide.setting.read: View system settings: GPS history retention, audit log retention.
guide.setting.manage: Change system settings: GPS retention, audit log auto-cleanup, clean now, export expired data; edit vehicle types.
guide.tenant.read: Open Organizations at system level (still limited to your own scope).
guide.tenant.manage: Create / edit / delete ANY organization, including the root (platform admins only).
guide.tenant.self_config: Edit your own unit's details (name, address, contacts…).
guide.tenant.subtree_read: View your unit and all sub-units with their data (vehicles, incidents, accounts…).
guide.tenant.subtree_manage: Add / edit / delete sub-units and act on data across the whole subtree.
guide.user.read: View accounts within scope (name, role, unit, last sign-in).
guide.user.manage: Create / edit / lock / delete accounts, reset passwords, change role and unit — only for accounts not more powerful than you.
guide.user.permission.grant: Grant / revoke individual permissions to other accounts (only ones you hold). Opens the Permission guide.

permGuide.title: Permission guide
permGuide.description: Permissions you can grant to accounts below you, what each one does and which roles already include it
permGuide.search: Search by name, code or meaning
permGuide.matrixHint: You can grant the {{count}} permissions below. ✓ means the role already includes it. Click a role to highlight it, a group to collapse it.

rules.effective: An account's permissions = its role's bundle + individually granted extras. Changing a role's bundle applies immediately to everyone holding that role.
rules.onlyOwn: You can only grant permissions you hold yourself — the table lists exactly those. You cannot grant to, revoke from or edit accounts with more power than you.
rules.scope: Every permission applies only within the account's organization / unit (and sub-units with a “subtree” permission). None reveals another organization's data, except platform permissions.
rules.web: Signing in to the web requires “Dashboard access”. For Custom accounts it is preselected on creation — untick it if the account does not need the web.
rules.app: App accounts (officers in vehicles) use the mobile app only and only see / act on their assigned vehicles.
rules.platform: “Platform” permissions can only be granted by system administrators; “Root org only” ones only to people in the root (operator) organization.
rules.flexible: Besides the 4 main roles there is only ONE flexible role, “Custom”: no built-in permissions, each account has its own set. If several accounts need the same set, create an organization role.

auditRetention.title: Audit log retention
auditRetention.policy: The audit log is evidence of who did what, so it can only be cleaned up by age (rows older than the limit), keeping at least {{min}} days. There is no way to delete individual rows or by person. Every configuration change and every cleanup is itself recorded in the audit log.
auditRetention.enable: Automatically clean up expired audit log (02:30 nightly)
auditRetention.enableHint: Off = keep the audit log forever
auditRetention.cleanupConfirm: Clean up {{count}} expired audit log rows now?
auditRetention.cleanupDesc: This cannot be undone. Export to Excel first to keep an archive.
